content.name: Ring of Warmth
entries: While wearing this ring, you have resistance to cold damage. In addition, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit.

content.name: Ring of Warmth
entries: If you take Cold damage while wearing this ring, the ring reduces the damage you take by {@dice 2d8}.
In addition, while wearing this ring, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.
